ContentTypes.description: Configures the default values applied to the content types created from the Content Types admin. The values can also be defined per tenant under 'OrchardCore:{TenantName}:ContentTypes'. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/ContentTypes/.

DefaultCategory.description: The category assigned to newly created content types, e.g. 'Widgets'.

DefaultThumbnailPath.description: The path of the thumbnail image assigned to newly created content types, e.g. '/media/thumbnails/default.png'. When empty, '~/OrchardCore.ContentTypes/placeholder.png' is used.

OrchardCore_ContentTypes.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_ContentTypes' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:ContentTypes' instead.
